name: Earth satellites
blurb: Low-Earth and polar-orbiting satellites around Earth — the International Space Station, Hubble Space Telescope, China's Tiangong (Tianhe core), NASA's Terra, and NOAA-20.
highlights: Crewed laboratory and visiting craft in low Earth orbit (ISS)
Hubble Space Telescope and Tiangong space station
compactnessNote: These spacecraft fly a few hundred to about 800 km above Earth's surface, far closer than the Moon.
